doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

rmb.source: Not determinable. Data (briefs/supervive-data/supervive_kits.md:74, Heartpiercer: hold, release) has no rule for Phase Walk during the charge. Footage: the Impaling charge frames (briefs/hero-ref/pin.md:91-110, f264-273, 0494) show no roll; both rolls in the clip (frames 0348 and 0388, footage/pin/frames 0340-0352 and 0380-0395) come out of a pale-V Bow draw with no gold bar, so neither is an Impaling charge. Whether the roll ends the charge or the charge survives it is not shown. Kept: Shift goes at once and the charge carries on (owner item 51 default; hold.rmb rows keep).

e.source: Not determinable. Rain of Arrows is a tap with no reticle (briefs/hero-ref/pin.md:124-131) and the wall then stands at the cursor for about 4.4 s on its own (f458-480). The notes record no roll in the E frames (0456-0500, 0457, 0498), and the rolls at 0348 and 0388 (footage/pin/frames 0340-0395) come with no E. Data (supervive_kits.md:76) silent. Whether a roll in the lob ends it is not shown. Kept: Shift goes at once and the rain goes on (owner item 51 default).

x.source: From the rules, not from frames: Primal Forces is a tap self-buff with no cast lock (briefs/hero-ref/pin.md:253-254) that ends after 3 shots or 6 s (pin.md:256, 280; supervive_kits.md:77 'next 3 Bow shots'), so there is no cast for the roll to cancel or wait for, and nothing in it ends on a roll: the roll runs beside it and the buff carries on. No roll inside the buff is shown (the ult frames, svvid/ult/pin f33-f129, are not on the footage branch; pin.md notes only walking between shots, :261).

lmb.source: Owner item 51 names Lace's draw: it carries through a dash. Neither the data (Myth: Greenwood Bow, Phase Walk) nor the footage (pin.md: Spirit Walk) shows the roll ending a draw, so Shift mid-draw rolls at once and the draw carries on.
